diagnosis: Cold switches repeatedly probe the local container and initialize a fresh decoder on the cut. Expensive first compressed packet submissions occur before a picture can be selected. Concurrent compositor calls can also block during decoder submission.

Some three-layer gaps show concurrent DXGI Present, packet submission and decoder device-lock contention. These are overlapping wall intervals. Driver and scheduling latency inside a blocked API call require separate attribution.

Staggering the three source-return phases in the same traced intermediate worker eliminated skips in one diagnostic run. In the synchronized reference trace its three largest missed intervals followed submissions four to six frames after a scheduled return. This supports overlap at rewind handoff as one failure mode. Its causal contribution to untraced second-long intervals remains unknown.

coarse_cut_observation.scope: The GUI samples status intermittently. The status frame can be an unsubmitted clock target and a skip counter rises only when the renderer submits a later picture. These windows cannot place individual gaps or associate them with a decoder or transfer.

full_master_observation.system_observation: Power-off request and subsequent kernel power transition after last progress receipt.

retained_cut_analysis.scope: Retained recorder-off status samples for the original synchronized fixture. This reconstruction groups skip charges between sampled submissions; it does not recover the order of individual skipped frames or the reason for any missing picture.
retained_cut_analysis.method: For each raw sample add the change in Present calls and the change in skips to the base completed sequence frame. Count a backward cut only when it lies strictly between consecutive reconstructed submitted frames in a window with a positive skip delta.
retained_cut_analysis.applicability: Each compared receipt has one active transport generation from base through drain, zero nonadvancing redraws and zero backwards draws. Its endpoint Present, submission and distinct counts are equal. Reconstructed submitted frames are nondecreasing, agree with the known 0 and 3599 endpoints, and never exceed the corresponding raw reported clock target.
retained_cut_analysis.outgoing_tail_question: The stalled-at-cut-minus-two observation places the last submitted frame before the final outgoing picture. These receipts do not tell whether that outgoing picture had a proved source interval or an eligible completed transfer during the stall.
